captions.instagram:
Same frames. Same doors. The only difference is the fillers.

IKEA PAX comes in set sizes and rooms don't, so there's always a gap to the ceiling and a strip of wall at the end. Close them with strips scribed to the wall and ceiling, and it reads as built in. Finchley, London.

My 22-page guide, IKEA PAX, built in, has the sums, the cut list and every step. Link in bio.
